name: Long Recall Variant 3
task:
Please complete the following four-stage document analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Data Extraction ===
A 45-page clinical trial report: 1,200 participants (page 4), treatment group: 600 (page 6), placebo group: 600 (page 7), efficacy rate 78% (page 15), side effects 12% (page 20), dropout rate 8% (page 25), cost per patient $3,500 (page 30), trial duration 18 months (page 35).

=== Stage 2: Calculation ===
Compute required metrics from extracted data.

=== Stage 3: Cross-Verification ===
Verify calculations against document sections.

=== Stage 4: Summary ===
Compile all findings.
